title: Chimneey Testament
tagline: Leave a Testament! Select a wallet to inherit your assets in case of loss.
description: The projects intends to provide an extra layer of security to wallets. Through the implementation of a "dead-mans-switch" contract, users can set a recipient wallet to inherit their assets in case of wallet access lost or actual death. User's can set a deadline (no pun intended 👻) and push it in intervals or cancel. Also, they can choose from a variety of charities for an inheritor.
how_its_made: Vue for the frontend (several labriries were used for styling, deply contract, RPC, etc), Walletconnect to connect wallets, ENS for more options at the time of adding recipients, OpenZeppelin for contract templates, QuickNode for Node, PushProtocol for notifications, Polygon as an L2.
